ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to Students in the History Honors Program. Meets with HIST 498, Section: B. Topic: Orientalism and Its Critics. Description: This course examines the ways in which the Orient has been imagined and described by Western missionaries, artists, filmmakers, and colonial administrators. This course requires original research in the library archives. Students are expected to work on group projects and presentations as well as individual research for a final paper.
